summary: On August 31, 2026, Chase General Corporation's subsidiary, Dye Candy Company, transferred substantially all business assets to lender G.W. Chase Candy Company LLC via a deed in lieu of foreclosure, discharging ~$500,000 in debt plus accrued interest. The registrant retains no residual interest and ceases operations except winding-up activities. This voluntary asset transfer avoids formal foreclosure proceedings and effectively concludes the company's operating business, signaling a wind-down or liquidation phase. Watch for subsequent dissolution or shareholder distributions as winding-up proceeds, with no ongoing operational risk-arbitrage angle.
